$comment: Performance budget for the production build (scripts/check-budget.ts, run in CI after the build). Bytes a first visit downloads: gzip size for text, raw size for binaries. frame: per-frame GPU work on the default view, measured 2026-09-30 at 46 draw calls on Low and 79 on High and Ultra (453 and 717 triangles); draw calls get about 10 % headroom, triangles are rounded up to 1,000. The e2e test checks the default quality. Raise a number only with a reason in docs/decisions.md.
